name: Fish of the Croatian Adriatic shallows

labels.oval: deep-bodied and flat-sided, like a plate seen edge-on
labels.torpedo: an ordinary fish shape, roughly three times as long as it is deep
labels.elongated: distinctly long and thin, five or more times as long as it is deep
labels.eel: snake-like, with no tail fin you could point to
labels.needle: as thin and straight as a pencil
labels.stocky: lumpy and broad-headed, propped on the bottom
labels.flat: a flatfish lying on its side, with both eyes on the upper side
labels.disc: a ray: a flat disc with wings and a thin whip tail

labels.tiny: tiny, shorter than a finger (under 6 cm)
labels.small: small, about a hand's length (6-18 cm)
labels.medium: medium, about a forearm's length (18-40 cm)
labels.large: large, longer than your forearm (over 40 cm)

colour.question: What colour did it mostly look?

labels.sandy: sand-coloured, almost invisible against the bottom

pattern.question: What markings did it have on its body?

labels.vertical_bars: vertical bars, running top to bottom
labels.horizontal_stripes: horizontal stripes, running head to tail
labels.dark_bands: one or two thick dark bands
labels.dark_flank_spot: a single dark smudge in the middle of the flank

labels.over_rocks: swimming just above rocks or reef
labels.in_seagrass: in or near a seagrass meadow
labels.in_caves: in a crack, cave or under an overhang
labels.open_water: out in open water, away from the bottom

labels.buried_in_sand: buried, with only eyes or outline showing
labels.head_out_of_a_hole: head out of a hole, body hidden
labels.clings_to_rock: clinging to a vertical rock face
labels.clings_to_weed: holding on to seagrass or weed

schooling.question: Was it in a school of many similar fish?

forked_tail.question: Was its tail clearly forked, like a V?

tail_spot.question: Was there a dark spot or ring right at the base of its tail?

snout.question: Anything unusual about its snout or jaw?

labels.long_beak: a long thin beak, like a needle
labels.tube: a small tube-shaped mouth at the end of a long snout

head_markings.question: Any distinctive marking on its head?

labels.blue_lines: wavy blue or violet scribbles on the cheek
labels.gold_band: a golden band between the eyes
labels.dark_eye_stripe: a dark stripe running through the eye
labels.black_ear_spot: a black spot just behind the eye
labels.dark_gill_spot: a dark smudge on the gill cover

barbels.question: Did it have whisker-like barbels under its chin?

big_eyes.question: Were its eyes unusually large for its head?

tentacles_above_eyes.question: Did it have small tentacles or tufts above its eyes?

venomous_spines.question: Did it look spiny or dangerous to touch?

visible_teeth.question: Could you make out prominent teeth?

entities.name: White seabream
entities._note: Diplodus sargus (šarag) - silver with thin dark bars and a black saddle right on the tail base.

entities.name: Two-banded seabream
entities._note: Diplodus vulgaris (fratar) - one dark band behind the head, another before the tail.

entities.name: Annular seabream
entities._note: Diplodus annularis (špar) - golden flanks, a black ring round the tail base, bright yellow pelvic fins.

entities.name: Sharpsnout seabream
entities._note: Diplodus puntazzo (pic) - barred like a white seabream but with a pointed, pig-like snout.

entities.name: Zebra seabream
entities._note: Diplodus cervinus - five broad dark bars, far thicker than a white seabream's. Uncommon inshore.

entities.name: Saddled seabream
entities._note: Oblada melanura (ušata) - plain silver with one bold black-and-white spot on the tail base.

entities.name: Salema
entities._note: Sarpa salpa (salpa) - golden stripes on silver, grazing in slow-moving schools.

entities.name: Bogue
entities._note: Boops boops (bukva) - slender, huge dark eyes, faint gold lines; hangs in midwater schools.

entities.name: Picarel
entities._note: Spicara smaris (gira) - slim and silvery with one dark smudge on the flank; dense schools.

entities.name: Gilt-head seabream
entities._note: Sparus aurata (orada, komarča) - heavy silver bream with a gold bar between the eyes.

_image.credit: (c) Julien Renoult, some rights reserved (CC BY)

entities.name: Striped seabream
entities._note: Lithognathus mormyrus (ovčica) - many thin bars, pointed snout, always over open sand.

entities.name: Black seabream
entities._note: Spondyliosoma cantharus (kantar) - dark grey with faint gold lines along the flank.

entities.name: Common pandora
entities._note: Pagellus erythrinus (arbun) - delicate pink bream over sand and rubble.

entities.name: Common dentex
entities._note: Dentex dentex (zubatac) - big steel-blue predator with obvious canines; appears from open water and is gone.

entities.name: Mediterranean rainbow wrasse
entities._note: Coris julis (knez) - a darting ribbon of orange, blue and white with a zigzag side stripe.

entities.name: Ornate wrasse
entities._note: Thalassoma pavo - turquoise and orange with one bright vertical band mid-body.

entities.name: Peacock wrasse
entities._note: Symphodus tinca (lumbrak) - mottled green, pottering along rock edges and seagrass.

entities.name: Five-spotted wrasse
entities._note: Symphodus roissali - small, stubby and heavily mottled; common in the top few metres.

entities.name: Ocellated wrasse
entities._note: Symphodus ocellatus - tiny and gaudy, with a black spot ringed in blue behind the eye.

entities.name: Brown wrasse
entities._note: Labrus merula - solid dark blue-green, thick-lipped, unhurried.

entities.name: Green wrasse
entities._note: Labrus viridis - large bright green wrasse of seagrass meadows; now scarce.

entities.name: Pearly razorfish
entities._note: Xyrichtys novacula - pink, blade-thin with a steep blunt forehead; dives headfirst into sand.

entities.name: Painted comber
entities._note: Serranus scriba (pirka) - brown bars plus unmistakable blue scribbles on the cheek.

entities.name: Comber
entities._note: Serranus cabrilla (kanjac) - barred like a painted comber but with no blue on the head.

entities.name: Dusky grouper
entities._note: Epinephelus marginatus (kirnja) - big mottled brown fish with a thick lower jaw, backed into a hole.

entities.name: Damselfish
entities._note: Chromis chromis (crnelj) - sooty-brown clouds above the reef; juveniles are electric blue.

_image.credit: (c) Julien Renoult, some rights reserved (CC BY)

entities.name: Cardinalfish
entities._note: Apogon imberbis (kralj od trilja) - orange-red with huge eyes, hanging in the dark of a cave.

_image.credit: This photo has been taken by Matthieu Sontag (User:Mirgolth) and released under the licenses stated below. Could you be kind enough to leave me a message on this page to inform me about your use of this picture.

entities.name: Brown meagre
entities._note: Sciaena umbra (kavala) - dark, high-backed, hovering motionless in a cave mouth.

entities.name: Striped red mullet
entities._note: Mullus surmuletus (trlja od kamena) - yellow side stripe, sloping forehead; sifts gravel and sand beside rock.

entities.name: Red mullet
entities._note: Mullus barbatus (trlja od blata) - plainer and pinker, with a steep blunt forehead; keeps to open sand and mud.

entities.name: Black scorpionfish
entities._note: Scorpaena porcus (škrpun) - lumpy, spiny and perfectly camouflaged. Venomous spines; do not touch.

entities.name: Red scorpionfish
entities._note: Scorpaena scrofa (škrpina) - the big red one, fringed with skin flaps. Venomous spines.

entities.name: Small red scorpionfish
entities._note: Scorpaena notata - a hand-sized red scorpionfish with a dark blotch on the spiny dorsal fin.

entities.name: Mediterranean moray
entities._note: Muraena helena (murina) - mottled snake-like body, jaw working, head out of a crack.

entities.name: Conger eel
entities._note: Conger conger (ugor) - plain grey eel, much smoother-looking than a moray.

entities.name: Forkbeard
entities._note: Phycis phycis (tabinja) - soft brown cave fish with long thread-like pelvic fins and a chin barbel.

entities.name: Shore rockling
entities._note: Gaidropsarus mediterraneus - small brown eel-ish fish with three barbels, under stones.

entities.name: Tompot blenny
entities._note: Parablennius gattorugine (babica) - propped on its fins with big branched tentacles over the eyes.

_image.credit: This illustration was made by Citron You must credit this : Citron / CC-BY-SA-3.0

entities.name: Striped blenny
entities._note: Parablennius rouxi - cream white with one clean black line from snout to tail.

entities.name: Rusty blenny
entities._note: Parablennius sanguinolentus - olive and blotchy, in the surge right at the waterline.

entities.name: Peacock blenny
entities._note: Salaria pavo - olive-gold with bars and a black spot behind the eye; males grow a head crest.

entities.name: Red black-faced blenny
entities._note: Tripterygion tripteronotum - thumb-sized; breeding males are scarlet with a black head.

entities.name: Yellow black-faced blenny
entities._note: Tripterygion delaisi - the same shape in lemon yellow, always in shade.

entities.name: Bucchich's goby
entities._note: Gobius bucchichi (glavoč) - sandy with rows of brown spots, often beside an anemone.

entities.name: Rock goby
entities._note: Gobius paganellus (glavoč) - dark and marbled, tucked under stones and ledges.

entities.name: Red-mouthed goby
entities._note: Gobius cruentatus (glavoč) - speckled brown with unmistakable bright red lips.

entities.name: Garfish
entities._note: Belone belone (iglica) - needle-thin with a long beak and green bones; skims the surface.

_image.credit: (c) Sarah Faulwetter, some rights reserved (CC BY)

entities.name: Grey mullet
entities._note: Mugilidae (cipal) - blunt-headed silver fish nosing about harbours and shallow bays.

entities.name: Sand smelt
entities._note: Atherina boyeri (gavun) - tiny and glassy with a silver side stripe; shimmering surface shoals.

entities.name: European seabass
entities._note: Dicentrarchus labrax (lubin, brancin) - large, plain silver with a dark gill-cover smudge; usually alone and unhurried.

entities.name: European barracuda
entities._note: Sphyraena sphyraena (škaram) - silver, faintly barred, jutting jaw; hangs motionless in the blue.

entities.name: Greater amberjack
entities._note: Seriola dumerili (gof) - powerful silver-blue fish with a dark bar through the eye.

entities.name: Mediterranean horse mackerel
entities._note: Trachurus mediterraneus (šnjur) - big-eyed blue-silver schooler with a bony ridge along the flank.

entities.name: Mediterranean parrotfish
entities._note: Sparisoma cretense - red or grey with a blunt beak; you often hear it crunching rock.

entities.name: Wide-eyed flounder
entities._note: Bothus podas - a speckled flat disc with both eyes on one side, half-buried in sand.

entities.name: Greater weever
entities._note: Trachinus draco (pauk) - buried in sand with only its eyes out. Venomous dorsal spines; the one to watch for.

_image.credit: Tomasz Sienicki [user: tsca, mail: tomasz.sienicki at gmail.com]

entities.name: Stargazer
entities._note: Uranoscopus scaber - buried with an upturned face and mouth; venomous shoulder spines.

entities.name: Common stingray
entities._note: Dasyatis pastinaca (žutulja) - grey diamond disc with a whip tail carrying a venomous spine.

entities.name: Marbled electric ray
entities._note: Torpedo marmorata (drhtulja) - rounded marbled disc that delivers an electric shock. Do not handle.

entities.name: Greater pipefish
entities._note: Syngnathus acus (morska igla) - a stiff living twig with a tube snout, drifting in seagrass.

entities.name: Long-snouted seahorse
entities._note: Hippocampus guttulatus (morski konjic) - upright and speckled, tail curled round a blade of weed.
